name: Refinery Atmospheric Crude Distillation Package
description: Standard petroleum refinery crude distillation unit (CDU) flowsheet featuring crude preheat train, fired process heater, 30-tray fractional distillation column, overhead condenser, reflux accumulator, and bottom reboiler circulation.
author: NebuDCS Standard Library
control_strategies: PIC-101 Column Head Pressure Control via Overhead Vapor/Condenser
TIC-101 Column Top Temperature Control via Reflux Flow
LIC-101 Column Bottoms Sump Level Control via Residue Draw
TIC-102 Furnace Coil Outlet Temperature Control via Fuel Gas Throttle
LIC-102 Reflux Drum Level Control via Overhead Distillate Take-off
validation_rules: VLD-REF01: Distillation column requires connected overhead condenser and reflux return
VLD-REF02: Fired heater fuel gas supply must be interlocked with process coil minimum flow
VLD-REF03: Atmospheric crude charge pump must maintain positive NPSH margin > 1.5m
